name: Death Lori
source:
■Murder Without Madness

99.9% of the time, people kill while still staying sane.
99.9% of the time, they manage to keep their sanity even after taking a life.
Sane, sane, sane, sane, sane, sane.
It’s not madness; it’s reason that drives the act of killing.

■Rationality is the Cruelest Reality

I want to be special.
I want to look cool.
I crave power beyond what I have.

These are thoughts we all have at some point—a normal way of thinking.
The main characters in our story also feel that way as they go through their everyday lives.
To outsiders, their lives might seem extraordinary.
But for them, it’s just the routine that sharpens the soul. Endless days that feel daunting to change. A compromise between dreams and reality.

■Fate Doesn’t Exist; Miracles Don’t Happen

In the midst of those ordinary days, they meet her.
She is everything they admire, envy, hate, and yearn to follow.
This is the world they've always dreamed of.

■Yearn for Power, Fear It, Indulge in It!

In a world built by those who can’t even let themselves go mad, the harshest truths come to light.

■Live awkwardly—and die awkwardly.


[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060409142246/http://mechanical-girl.web.infoseek.co.jp/frame.html]the official website[/url]]
